name: digitalbrain-lsp
description: Activates Claude Code's built-in LSP tool for DigitalBrain: C# via the repo-pinned `dotnet tool run csharp-ls` (no global binary), and Dart via `dart language-server`. No official marketplace plugin fits this repo (C# is a pinned local dotnet tool; Dart has no official plugin at all), so this ships in-repo. Only command/args/extensionToLanguage are set: Claude Code v2.1.143 hard-fails LSP init on the documented-but-unimplemented optional fields (restartOnCrash, maxRestarts, shutdownTimeout, etc.).
